text: Ironvale Athletic build their attack from the left side of their own half after a free kick. Teo Quinlan passes the ball forward to Jonah Lindqvist near the left edge of the penalty area. Lindqvist quickly plays a short pass to Oskar Lindgren, who sends a through ball splitting the Redmond Rovers’ defenders. Lindqvist runs onto it just 3.8 metres from goal at the left side of the six-yard box and shoots with his foot into the net. The score changes to 1-2 with Ironvale Athletic taking the lead [#1153] [#1154] [#1155] [#1156] [#1157].
